language.title: Khetha ulimi lwakho
language.subtitle: Ungalushintsha kamuva kumenyu.
home.subtitle: Khetha ividiyo noma isithombe, engeza ingoma namagama, bese ukhipha ividiyo eqediwe.
image.lengthBody: Khetha ukuthi lesi sithombe sizodlala isikhathi esingakanani.
image.audioRequired: Engeza ingoma. Lesi sithombe asinayo umsindo waso.
about.title: Mayelana
about.copy1: I-AI LyricVid ifaka amagama ahambisana nesikhathi phezu kwevidiyo. Khetha ikliphu, sesha ingoma, hloba amagama, bese ukhipha i-MP4 kulayibhrari yakho.
about.copy2: Ukuhlela nokukhipha kuhlala kule divayisi. Ukuthola ingoma kuthumela ikliphu yomsindo emfushane ku-Shazam ukuze kuhlonzwe ingoma. Awudingi i-akhawunti.
editor.title: Umhleli wamagama
detect.title: Kutholwe ingoma?
detect.body: Kuhlonzwe umsindo wale vidiyo bese kulayishwa amagama ngokuzenzakalelayo?
detect.noLyricsBody: U-{{artist}} — {{title}} uhlonziwe, kodwa i-LRCLIB ayinawo amagama. Sebenzisa Sesha amagama ukuze uzame omunye umphumela.
detect.failFallback: Zama Thola kusuka emsindweni kokuthi Sesha amagama.
detect.needsBuild: Ukuthola kudinga uhlelo lwe-AI LyricVid ukuze lusike ikliphu yomsindo emfushane. I-Expo Go ayikwazi ukwenza lokhu.
detect.unrecognized: I-Shazam ayizange yahlonza le kliphu. Zama enye indawo evidiyweni, noma useshe ngegama.
detect.noToken: Setha i-credentials/shazam.properties ku-.env ukuze uvule ukuthola ingoma.
media.photoPermission: Imvume yelayibhrari yezithombe iyadingeka ukuze ukhethe ividiyo.
search.rateLimit: Umkhawulo we-LRCLIB ufinyelelwe. Zama futhi emva kwemizuzwana engu-{{seconds}}.
lyrics.synced: Amagama avumelanisiwe alayishiwe. Thepha umugqa ukuze uye lapho.
lyrics.beyondVideo: Kukhombiswa yonke ingoma. Ukubuka kuqala nokukhipha kuyama ekupheleni kwevidiyo; imigqa elandelayo ihlala ohlwini.
lyrics.cannotSplitBody: Lo mugqa udinga okungenani amagama amabili.
lyrics.startFromBody: Susa yonke imigqa ngenhla bese uhambisa izikhathi ukuze lo uqale ngo-00:00.00.
lyrics.pastePlaceholder: Namathisela i-LRC noma amagama avamile nganoma yiluphi ulimi
lyrics.warningPaste: Anamathiselwe njengamagama angavumelanisiwe. Izikhathi zilandela ingoma, hhayi ubude bevidiyo.
lyrics.warningUnsynced: Kutholakale amagama angavumelanisiwe kuphela. Izikhathi zabiwe ngokulingana — zilungise ohlwini.
lyrics.warningNone: Awukho amagama abe namathiselwe kulo mphumela.
search.title: Thola amagama
search.needVideo: Khetha ividiyo kuqala ukuze uthole ingoma kusuka emculweni wayo.
search.noMatches: Ayikho imiphumela ku-LRCLIB. Zama elinye isihloko noma wengeze umculi.
search.pickSong: Khetha ingoma. Umhleli uzofaka amagama ayo wonke, noma ividiyo imfushane.
search.detectNeedVideo: Khetha ividiyo kuqala, bese uthola ingoma emsindweni wayo.
search.detectNoLyrics: I-Shazam ithole u-{{artist}} — {{title}}, kodwa i-LRCLIB ayinawo amagama. Sesha ngesinye isipelingi, noma unamathisele amagama.

split.title: Hlukanisa umugqa
split.help: Thepha igama lokugcina okufanele lihlale kulo mugqa. Okusele kuba umugqa omusha ngaphansi.
split.needWords: Lo mugqa udinga okungenani amagama amabili ukuze uhlukaniswe.
sync.title: Ukuhambisa isikhathi
sync.help: Hambisa yonke imigqa ndawonye uma amagama eqala kancane ngaphambi noma ngemva kwevidiyo.
sync.unsynced: La magama awavumelaniswanga ngomugqa. Sebenzisa ukuhambisa nezikhathi ku-Amagama.
audio.keepHelp: Ukubuka kuqala kusebenzisa umsindo osevele ukhona evidiyweni ({{duration}}).
audio.replaceHelp: Khetha i-mp3 noma i-wav. Ukubuka kuqala nokukhipha kuyama ebude bevidiyo ({{duration}}).
audio.imageHelp: Ividiyo izoba ngu-{{duration}}. Amagama nokukhipha kusetshenzisa lobo bude.
style.hint: Hudula ibhokisi lamagama evidiyweni ukuze ulibeke kabusha.
stickers.help: Thepha isitikha ukuze uyengeze, bese uyihudula noma kuphi evidiyweni noma esithombeni. Isihloko sengoma sivela esitikhini.
export.readyShare: {{filename}} ilungile. Sebenzisa ishidi lesistimu ukuze uyilondoloze noma uyabelane.
export.hiresBody: Lo msindo uyi-Hi-Res. Khetha ifayela elingu-44.1 noma 48 kHz, bese ukhipha futhi.
export.expoGo: Vula uhlelo lwe-AI LyricVid kusukela ekwakhiweni kwe-Android/iOS ukuze ukhiphe. I-Expo Go ayikwazi ukudala i-MP4 eqediwe.
export.needAudio: Engeza ifayela lomsindo ngaphambi kokukhipha lesi sithombe.
export.copyFailed: Ayikwazanga ukukopisha ividiyo esitolo sohlelo ukuze ikhishwe.
export.alreadyOnDevice: Le vidiyo isivele isedivayisini yakho. Londoloza amafayela wamazwibela uwaqambe ngokufana nevidiyo.
export.needsBuild: Ukukhipha ividiyo eqediwe kudinga uhlelo lwe-AI LyricVid. I-Expo Go ayikwazi ukushisa amagama ku-MP4. Vula uhlelo olufakwe kusukela ekwakhiweni kwe-Android/iOS, bese ukhipha futhi.
